textContent.value:
1 Beans Received = 1 Point

Top 1 will receive 10,000 beans as reward
Top 2 will receive 5,000 beans as reward
Top 3 will receive 2,000 beans as reward
Top 4-10 will receive 500 beans as reward
Top 11 - 50 will receive 100 benas as reward

⚠️ Note:
Any beans received via the Box during the event period will be audited and excluded from the final ranking. If disqualified, the reward will be passed down to the next eligible participant.
-We will conduct an audit on Overseas beans (beans received outside of the US/CA region); if the proportion of Overseas beans exceeds 20% of the total beans received, no rewards will be issued 🌍
-Go live for at least 20 mins is required 🕘
- Please do not choose the same time as your other Power Rebate events, otherwise we will only launch the higher reward 🔝
